tags.fixme: Runway closure needs confirmation. Personal observation of aircraft landing recently.

tags.note: All circuits to be East of the N7. Over-flying of the ostrich farm to the Northeast is to be avoided and circuits over the N7 are not permitted. See AIC 21.33

tags.warning: Powerlines at north-eastern end of runway

tags.note: Constructed during WW2 to support anti-submarine patrols in the Indian Ocean shipping lanes. Hangar at the rear of the apron has been removed.
